# fixture: synthetic engineering measurement

Only synthetic fixed observations; this is not a financial or causal study.
Metric: synthetic improvement in points; larger is better. There is no pre-agreed meaningful-effect threshold.

| Period | Cases | Baseline mean | Candidate mean | Difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| early | 9 | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| late | 1 | 1 | 10 | +9 |
| overall (old summary) | 10 | 1 | 5 | +4 |

The old summary has not yet been checked against row-level observations.csv. Necessary core question: does the overall improvement hold when all eligible observations are treated equally? This study can answer descriptive arithmetic only. It cannot determine a real-world causal mechanism or generalize to new observations.
